name: Rhino
summary: Aleksei Sytsevich is bonded to a rhino-shaped armor and used as a blunt instrument against Spider-Man. He remains a core member of the rogues’ gallery and also appears in Insomniac’s games.
creators: Stan Lee and John Romita Sr.
powers: Super strength and durability from the rhino suit, which he cannot easily remove.
origin: A hired muscle whose experimental suit became permanent.
